title: File System: Directory listing (getdents64 batch read)

context_files.reason: Syscall security: buffer bounds, path validation

acceptance_criteria: dir_open(path) opens directory and returns file descriptor
dir_read(fd, buffer, size) calls getdents64 syscall with 64KB buffer
dir_entry struct defined: inode, offset, reclen, type, name
Hidden files (starting with '.') filtered or flagged
Handles directories with 10,000+ entries without buffer overflow
Unit test lists /tmp entries and verifies count > 0
